title: MLAgentBench: Evaluating Language Agents on Machine Learning Experimentation
focus_en: Lets agents inspect files, run experiments, and improve ML models in an executable testbed. The records support analysis of planning and experimentation.
focus_zh: 让智能体在可执行环境中检查文件、运行实验并改进 ML 模型，利用过程记录分析规划和实验行为。
boundary_en: Datasets and research goals are supplied; model improvement measures experimentation ability, not autonomous selection of scientifically important questions.
boundary_zh: 数据集与研究目标由环境给定；模型改进衡量实验能力，不直接评价自主选择重要科学问题的能力。

title: MLE-bench: Evaluating Machine Learning Agents on Machine Learning Engineering
focus_en: Tests data preparation, model training, and experiment iteration on Kaggle tasks. Includes human competition baselines and analyses of compute scaling and data contamination.
focus_zh: 用 Kaggle 任务测试数据准备、模型训练和实验迭代，并提供人类竞赛基线，分析计算预算和数据污染的影响。
boundary_en: Measures ML engineering under specified objectives, not research taste; leaderboard submissions were paused in April 2026 pending comparability improvements.
boundary_zh: 衡量给定目标下的 ML engineering，不直接衡量 research taste；官方排行榜于 2026 年 4 月暂停接收新提交以改进可比性。

title: PaperBench: Evaluating AI's Ability to Replicate AI Research
focus_en: Tests whether agents can reproduce ML papers: implement the method, run it, and match the results. Authors help define the rubrics; the automated judge is also evaluated.
focus_zh: 检验智能体能否实现 ML 论文的方法、运行实验并复现结果。原作者参与制定评分标准，自动评审器也接受单独评估。
boundary_en: The paper to reproduce is supplied. Code-Dev scores implementation; full replication also requires execution and results. Neither measures original question selection.
boundary_zh: 待复现论文由环境给定。Code-Dev 评价代码实现，完整复现还要求执行和结果；二者都不评价原创问题选择。

title: MLGym: A New Framework and Benchmark for Advancing AI Research Agents
focus_en: Provides research tasks in vision, language, reinforcement learning, and games through a Gym-style interface. Supports agent evaluation and learning algorithms for research behavior.
focus_zh: 通过 Gym 式接口提供视觉、语言、强化学习与博弈研究任务，用于评价智能体和开发科研行为学习算法。
boundary_en: Exploration happens within supplied tasks; improved benchmark scores alone do not establish novel algorithms or learned scientific judgment.
boundary_zh: 探索发生在给定任务内；benchmark 分数提高本身不足以证明算法创新或科学判断力的学习。

title: AIRS-Bench: a Suite of Tasks for Frontier AI Research Science Agents
focus_en: Asks agents to solve ML tasks drawn from papers without baseline code. Tests idea generation, experiment analysis, and iterative improvement across domains.
focus_zh: 要求智能体在没有基线代码的情况下解决来自 ML 论文的任务，测试跨领域的构思、实验分析和迭代改进。
boundary_en: Each task supplies a problem, dataset, and metric; exceeding a reference score does not demonstrate autonomous problem discovery or scientific significance.
boundary_zh: 每个任务仍给定问题、数据集与指标；超过参考分数不等于自主发现研究问题或证明科学意义。

title: MLR-Bench: Evaluating AI Agents on Open-Ended Machine Learning Research
focus_en: Uses workshop research topics to evaluate ideas, proposals, experiments, and papers with MLR-Judge, assessing research outputs beyond a single prediction score.
focus_zh: 以 workshop 研究主题为任务，用 MLR-Judge 评价想法、方案、实验和论文，考察单一预测分数之外的研究产出。
boundary_en: Topics are supplied. LLM review scores are only proxies for research quality; experiments, novelty, and value still need independent checks.
boundary_zh: 研究主题由环境给定。LLM 评审分数只是研究质量的代理，实验、新颖性和价值仍需独立核验。

title: RE-Bench: Evaluating frontier AI R&D capabilities of language model agents against human experts
focus_en: Provides AI research engineering tasks and expert human attempts. Compares agent performance, search strategies, and the gains from additional time.
focus_zh: 提供 AI 科研工程任务和人类专家尝试记录，比较智能体表现、搜索策略，以及增加时间预算带来的收益。
boundary_en: A historical reference for bounded AI R&D tasks, not research taste; the official task repository is now deprecated.
boundary_zh: 适合作为有限 AI R&D 任务的历史参考，不直接评价 research taste；官方任务仓库目前已标记 deprecated。

title: FML-bench: A Controlled Study of AI Research Agent Strategies from the Perspective of Search Dynamics
focus_en: Uses shared execution tools to compare how research agents explore and improve solutions. Separates search strategy from execution infrastructure and records the research process.
focus_zh: 用统一执行工具比较科研智能体如何探索和改进方案，将搜索策略与执行基础设施分开，并记录研究过程。
boundary_en: Agents improve supplied baseline code on fixed tasks; the 2026 main-branch version differs from the 2025 legacy benchmark and should not be conflated with it.
boundary_zh: 智能体在固定任务上改进给定基线代码；2026 年 main 版本与 2025 年 legacy 版本不同，不应混用任务与结论。

title: ScienceAgentBench: Toward Rigorous Assessment of Language Agents for Data-Driven Scientific Discovery
focus_en: Tests generated programs on expert-checked tasks from published science. Uses execution results to assess reliability and separately records cost.
focus_zh: 用来自已发表研究、经专家核验的任务测试生成程序，根据执行结果评价可靠性，并单独记录成本。
boundary_en: Evaluates specified data-driven tasks rather than unrestricted discovery; use the April 2026 verified split to reduce known false-negative grading issues.
boundary_zh: 评价指定的数据驱动任务，而非无限制的科学发现；应使用 2026 年 4 月发布的 verified split 减少已知评分假阴性。

title: DiscoveryBench: Towards Data-Driven Discovery with Large Language Models
focus_en: Tests hypothesis search and verification on real and synthetic datasets. Scores the components of discovered relationships, going beyond whether code runs.
focus_zh: 在真实与合成数据集上测试假设搜索和验证，按发现关系的各个部分评分，评价范围超出代码能否运行。
boundary_en: Datasets and discovery goals are provided, and findings are compared with reference hypotheses; this does not evaluate choosing an unrestricted research agenda.
boundary_zh: 数据集与发现目标由环境提供，结果与参考假设比较；不评价自主选择不受限研究议程的能力。

title: DISCOVERYWORLD: A Virtual Environment for Developing and Evaluating Automated Scientific Discovery Agents
focus_en: A simulated environment evaluates cycles of hypothesis formation, intervention, experimentation, and explanation, including discovered knowledge alongside task completion.
focus_zh: 在模拟环境中评价假设形成、干预、实验和解释的完整循环，同时衡量任务完成与获得的解释性知识。
boundary_en: Controlled simulations make discovery behavior inspectable, but success does not establish transfer to real science or independent selection of significant questions.
boundary_zh: 受控模拟便于检查发现行为，但其中的成功不能直接证明向真实科学的迁移或重要问题的自主选择。

title: FrontierMath: A Benchmark for Evaluating Advanced Mathematical Reasoning in AI
focus_en: Tests difficult mathematical reasoning and computational investigation on expert-written problems with automatically checkable answers.
focus_zh: 用专家编写、答案可自动检查的高难度数学问题，测试数学推理与计算探索。
boundary_en: This entry concerns the original answer-checked benchmark, not formal proof verification or autonomous conjecture selection; correctness alone does not measure research taste.
boundary_zh: 本条指原始答案检查型 benchmark，不代表形式化证明验证或自主猜想选择；正确性本身不衡量 research taste。
